user_goal: 学会真实设计师从失败草稿到成熟字形的选择条件/审美否决，而非复制已设计成品、乱改笔宽、只跑几何通过。
hard_cost_constraint: No new paid tools/models/hosting; GitHub Actions standard runner only.
evidence_bounds: Use actual creator first-party before/after diagrams and their own linked prose. Do not call finished type specimens actual revision.
In a color-overlaid before/after figure, RGB/color area may prove presence of colored phases, never human quality or gesture motion.
Do not upload source image bytes, screenshots of third-party assets, extracted contours, or font files into public repository.
Treat creator action described in article separately from inferred shape intent based solely on figure.
A single glyph revision is not sufficient to prove style transfer to another glyph or whole wordmark.
Do not execute Figma generative/image models; user budget for newly connected fee-bearing model is 0.
Only stage with raw-byte integrity, concrete visible phases and author process text is eligible for rule extraction.

cases.creator: 郑初阳 / Typotheque
cases.original_stages: red before, blue after in same official author article
cases.process_author_claim: Revision of the proportion of 阝 primary radical at font-family scale; designer also describes a separate overly wide 口 decision reversed after many characters.
cases.independent_visual_claim: Two differently colored outlines and before/after word specimens are in one figure; exact direction of 阝 width change not yet quantitatively established.
cases.negative_bound: Do NOT substitute the wide-口 decision as if author explicitly said that about 阝.

cases.creator: justfont 金萱设计团队
cases.original_stages: yellow before silhouette outline, green after fill in same creator-owned figure
cases.process_author_claim: Replanning required retraining on basic 300 characters; half-sugar stage curves had to be reviewed and adjusted for style consistency.
cases.independent_visual_claim: Before-vs-after overlay on 秀, with local contour differences including bottom hooked form.
cases.negative_bound: The article's separate claim that overly-curved hooks hurt long-form readability is NOT explicitly said to be the cause of this exact 秀 diagram.

cases.creator: justfont 金萱设计团队
cases.original_stages: yellow before edges versus green after filled text
cases.process_author_claim: On ultralight body text, curve quality becomes more visible; designers refined them repeatedly. In long text they reduced overpowering bending/upturning hooks.
cases.independent_visual_claim: Visible after shape and highlighted before edge; exact letter identities and local change to verify against original pixels.
cases.negative_bound: Do not presume author provided an ordered stroke trajectory.

cases.creator: 高田裕美 / Morisawa, official iFontCloud interview
cases.original_stages: Black original vs corrected glyph illustrated on right; grey marks localized changes
cases.process_author_claim: User-observation in low-vision classroom changed design criteria; at 2000 glyphs, round stopped-feeling terminals reported unnatural, triggering wider re-review.
cases.independent_visual_claim: Local before/after glyph figures with grey edited area; source may use Japanese variants; exact stage wording should not be inferred from any paraphrased secondary caption.
cases.negative_bound: Interview cites 木-type terminal issues but figure itself is 反、北, so do not assert they are the same directly revised glyph.

future_required: Create source-to-revision choice examples with decision rationale and counterexample. Do not claim learned transferable creative method unless unseen glyph artwork judged by humans.
